rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—specifically S11 and IDD—by adding a source degeneration inductor in series with the NMOS transistor’s source, which enhances input matching (S11) by increasing the input impedance magnitude while simultaneously reducing the DC current through the transistor by increasing effective source impedance. This dual benefit addresses both the S11 margin (currently -0.00874) and the IDD violation (19.22 mA vs 15 mA max) without affecting NF or S21, which are already comfortably within bounds. The inductor also preserves narrowband operation via resonant tuning with parasitic capacitances, aligning with the 45nm CMOS process constraints.
